pages.text: $(bold)Squeezing Machine$(): right-click with squeezable ingredients to add them (stacks of 64).$(br)$(bold)Right-click$() with an empty hand to start squeezing - it takes a fixed 4 seconds.$(br2)When done, right-click with an empty hand to collect the results; extra results drop beside the machine when the output is full.$(br)$(bold)Shift-right-click$() to take out the ingredients.
